LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SpringFlow.label: spring flow
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SpringFlow.description: A clear spring moves with springtime between stones, quiet yet tangible. Unlocks Flower Decree: Spring Flow.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chuanhun.label: soulbreak absolute note
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chuanhun.description: Unlocked by "Feihua Jueyu". Creates a sonic burst at a distant target location, stunning targets in the area, dealing psychic damage, and increasing Flower Decree maximum.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Shuangyuejing.label: frost bloom
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Shuangyuejing.description: Unlocked by "Duanqiao Canxue". Summons a circular ice curtain that freezes and absorbs hostile projectiles passing through it, and increases Flower Decree maximum.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaoshan.label: mountain resolve
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaoshan.description: Unlocked by "Gaoshan". Increases Divine Protection shield capacity.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Liushui.label: flowing resilience
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Liushui.description: Unlocked by "Liushui". Increases Divine Protection recharge speed.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chunjiang.label: river moon intent
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chunjiang.description: Unlocked by "Chunjiang Huayueye". Shortens Divine Protection's disabled delay after the shield breaks, letting it recharge sooner.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_DivineGrace.label: divine grace
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_DivineGrace.description: Qinghe's mastery node. Each level deepens her own cultivation; concrete effects are applied by Qinghe's passive systems.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Yingyue.label: moon-reflection fragment
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Yingyue.description: Unlocked by "Erquan Yingyue". Increases the available charges of Divine Blessing.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_NishangDance.label: Nishang dance
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_NishangDance.description: Unlocked by "Nishang Yuyi Dance". Unlocks dance skill: Flower Dance.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.label: Sword Form: Jueying
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.description: A new dance technique Qinghe learned after exchanging forms with her teacher Neiyu. Bell tones become sword qi, carrying the breathtaking speed of Sword Form: Skyfall and Qinghe's own cutting art. Unlocks dance skill: Sword Form: Jueying, which deals double damage to hostile buildings in its cone.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.label: Luoshui rite
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.description: Unlocked by "Luoshen Fu". Unlocks ability: Luoshen's ribbon.
